name: drawio-skill
tagline_zh: 画图前不用再想用什么工具。丢给它一段K8s清单或Transformer结构，直接产出可编辑的drawio图。
tagline_en: Stop choosing diagram tools. Feed it K8s manifests or a Transformer block—get editable drawio files, even SysML.
desc_en: Use when the user requests diagrams, flowcharts, architecture diagrams, ER diagrams, UML / sequence / class diagrams, SysML / MBSE diagrams (block definition, internal block, requirement, parametric), BPMN business process diagrams, swimlane / cross-functional flowcharts, network topology, cloud architecture from Terraform or Kubernetes manifests, ML/DL model figures (Transformer/CNN/LSTM), mind m
why_zh: 不是又一个画板，而是把结构化输入翻译成图。它懂Terraform、K8s、UML、BPMN。
why_en: Not another canvas—it parses structured input (Terraform, K8s, UML, BPMN, SysML) and wires nodes by semantics, not keyword.
limit_zh: 只认文本/代码输入，不认手绘草图或图片。输出是.drawio源文件，不含渲染预览。SysML只覆盖需求图、块定义。
limit_en: Text/code input only—no sketches or images. Outputs .drawio source, no preview. SysML limited to req/bdd/ibd/par; other diagram types are refused.
title_en: One diagram for Terraform, K8s, ML, UML & BPMN
